title: Write consolidation tests
description:
Create tests/test_consolidation.py.

Write comprehensive tests for all four consolidation modules:

Summarizer tests:
- summarize_turn returns a non-empty string for valid input messages
- summarize_session correctly rolls up multiple turn summaries
- summarize_long_term handles empty input gracefully
- Summarizer is idempotent: same input produces same output (mock the Provider)

ContradictionResolver tests:
- Rule-based contradiction: same subject, conflicting values → has_contradiction=True
- Rule-based non-contradiction: different subjects or same values → has_contradiction=False
- Temporal contradiction: incorrect ordering → detected
- Preference reversal: detected
- Empty/None entries: handled without exception, returns has_contradiction=False
- Idempotency: same pair always returns identical ContradictionResult
- LLM fallback is called only for ambiguous cases (mock Provider)

MemoryDecayEngine tests:
- Entries older than half-life receive lower decay scores
- Recently accessed entries are boosted
- Entries below relevance_threshold are pruned
- Empty input returns empty list
- All entries above threshold: none pruned
- All entries below threshold: all pruned
- Idempotency: same inputs produce same pruned list

ConsolidationWorker tests:
- run_consolidation runs the full pipeline when work exists
- Coalescing window: second call within window returns empty result
- Transactional rollback: simulated DB failure does not corrupt state
- ConsolidationResult fields are populated correctly

Use pytest with fixtures and mocks. Do NOT require a real database or LLM provider — mock all external dependencies.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/consolidation/summarizer.py
- chatbot/consolidation/contradiction.py
- chatbot/consolidation/decay.py
- chatbot/consolidation/worker.py
- tests/test_consolidation.py (if it exists)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover Summarizer: summarize_turn, summarize_session, summarize_long_term, idempotency
Tests cover ContradictionResolver: rule-based conflicts, non-conflicts, temporal, preference, edge cases, idempotency
Tests cover MemoryDecayEngine: age decay, access boost, threshold pruning, edge cases, idempotency
Tests cover ConsolidationWorker: full pipeline, coalescing window, transactional rollback, result fields
All external dependencies (Provider, DB, memory store) are mocked; no real LLM calls
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add new third-party dependencies without justification
